finalText: Created the handoff document at `ON_CALL_HANDOFF.md`. It covers the root cause (Redis connection failure), exact 17.5-minute impact window (02:14:07–02:31:45 UTC), the cascade sequence, and notes that the exact ioredis version is unknown without a lock file—only the spec `^5.4.1` from package.json is available. On-call can check the production node_modules to get the exact version.
